messages.author: a1805303aff0af2e
messages.subject: error while applying cfa(): cannot open the connection
parts:
Dear all,

I ran into a problem while doing confirmatory analysis with the cfa() in "lavaan" package. To show an example, I use the built-in data "HolzingerSwineford1939":

> HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3 
+               textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
+               speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '
> 
> fit <- cfa(HS.model, data = HolzingerSwineford1939)

Error in file(file, "r") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "r") : cannot open file ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3 
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 ': Invalid argument

Anyone can tell me why I kept getting this error?

messages.author: a1805303aff0af2e
messages.subject: Re: error while applying cfa(): cannot open the connection
parts: problem solved after I remove the "sem" package from the work space.
